description: `POST /api/inspections` had no idempotency protection. Concurrent same-key retries could create duplicate inspection rows + duplicate Trust Spine record_created events + duplicate safety/PM notification fanout.
fix: Wrapped create_inspection body in `_do_create` and called `with_idempotency(db · key · {\"role\":\"public\"} · _do_create · workflow=\"inspection\")`.

description: `POST /api/equipment-inspections` (Pre-Op / DVIR) had no idempotency protection. Concurrent same-key retries could create duplicate inspections and (on fail) duplicate Maintenance Holds.
fix: Wrapped create_equipment_inspection body in `_do_create` and called `with_idempotency(db · key · {\"role\":\"public\"} · _do_create · workflow=\"equipment_inspection\")`. Workflow bucket distinguishes preop from dvir at the Trust Spine layer already; the reservation-lock scopes at equipment_inspection level.
Wrapped create_jha body in `_do_create` and called `with_idempotency(db · key · {\"role\":\"public\"} · _do_create · workflow=\"jha\")`.
